ROSTER.name: Bramble
ROSTER.role: Grassland ranger · precise arrows and a billhook
ROSTER.primary: Quickdraw — loose a fast aimed arrow.
ROSTER.block: Briar buckler — hold the folding forearm shield toward danger.
ROSTER.special: Briarshot — branches brace the bow; arrows pierce and briefly root their last target.

ROSTER.name: Morel
ROSTER.primary: Reagent flask — throw a flask that leaves a short-lived reagent patch.
ROSTER.secondary: Catalyst — send a spark through prepared patches, or burst at close range.
ROSTER.block: Mineral ward — hold an alchemical shield.
ROSTER.special: Catalyst mask — apparatus opens; flasks ignite nearby patches in a finite chain reaction.

ROSTER.name: Velvet
ROSTER.role: Coastal duellist · sabre and black lantern
ROSTER.primary: Sabre — cut in a quick frontal arc.
ROSTER.secondary: Lantern flare — dazzle nearby enemies and expose them to a follow-up.
ROSTER.block: Sabre parry — hold the blade across incoming blows.
ROSTER.special: Black Lantern — movement leaves finite pale echoes; a successful guard primes a long counter-thrust.

ROSTER.name: Cairn
ROSTER.primary: Stone fist — a heavy close-range punch.
ROSTER.secondary: Boulder — throw a stone that stops at its first impact.
ROSTER.special: Old Growth — roots brace the arms; punches launch a ground shockwave and boulders slam on impact.

ROSTER.name: Iona
ROSTER.primary: Spearpoint — thrust along a narrow lane.
ROSTER.secondary: Wind lunge — commit to a forward surge and spear strike.
ROSTER.block: Gust guard — brace the spear in a frontal wind screen.
ROSTER.special: Storm Mantle — spear impacts arc to one nearby foe; lunges leave a gust wake.

ROSTER.name: Tam
ROSTER.role: Frostline ice monk · disciplined close control
ROSTER.primary: Frost palms — palm and elbow strikes build frost.
ROSTER.secondary: Ice ridge — send a narrow ridge along the ground.
ROSTER.block: Ice guard — cross the forearms behind a frost plate.
ROSTER.special: Glacier Form — ice coats the limbs; movement glides, repeated strikes briefly bind then shatter frost.

ROSTER.name: Brine
ROSTER.role: Coastal diver · harpoon gun and integral winch
ROSTER.primary: Harpoon gun — fire one tethered harpoon, then reload the integral reel.
ROSTER.secondary: Reel — pull a light target or winch toward an anchored heavy target; untethered, sweep the gun butt.
ROSTER.block: Dive brace — lower the gun and hold the reinforced forearm guard.
ROSTER.special: Abyssal Drive — the winch overdrives; heavy piercing shots and stronger controlled reeling.

ROSTER.name: Pendle
ROSTER.primary: Revolver — one accurate shot; six rounds before a full reload.
ROSTER.secondary: Fan fire — fan up to three remaining revolver rounds in a narrow spread, then reload. During Longshot, strike nearby enemies with the rifle stock instead.
ROSTER.block: Steel plate — fold out the forearm plate.
ROSTER.special: Longshot — holster the revolver and draw a western marksman rifle; slow, penetrating shots replace the primary.

ROSTER.name: Mirra
ROSTER.primary: Water bolt — an aimed current; firing through a spring seal widens it.
ROSTER.secondary: Spring seal — place a finite pool at the aimed point, within reach.
ROSTER.block: Water curtain — hold a frontal flowing shield.
ROSTER.special: Oasis Unbound — seals connect in damaging currents; new seals redirect the network.

ROSTER.name: Ashe
ROSTER.role: Sunstone ember knight · sword and cinder armour
ROSTER.primary: Ember blade — sweep the sword in a close arc.
ROSTER.secondary: Ember thrust — a committed, longer thrust.
ROSTER.block: Armoured guard — brace the sword and shoulder plate.
ROSTER.special: Cinderhelm — put on the closed helmet; sword blows cast flame crescents and the form ends in an aimed fire finisher.

ROSTER.name: Clack
ROSTER.primary: Shoulder rocket — fire a visible rocket with a bounded blast radius; reload between shots.
ROSTER.secondary: Concussive vent — release a short-range space-clearing blast from the launcher’s separate pressure chamber, including while its rocket loader reloads.
ROSTER.block: Blast guard — unfold the launcher shield.
ROSTER.special: Siegebreaker — the loader and shoulder brace unfold; three-rocket salvos replace single shots while the gunner remains mobile.

ROSTER.name: Nix
ROSTER.role: Neon Harbour cyborg · laser arm, heat and misdirection
ROSTER.primary: Laser arm — emit a narrow, aimable pulse; sustained use builds heat and the arm cools passively.
ROSTER.secondary: Afterimage — leave one stationary hologram at the activation origin while moving freely; it attracts enemy attacks and breaks at the first hit or after three seconds.
ROSTER.block: Arm shield — hold a compact energy guard.
ROSTER.special: Limit Release — arm casing opens; narrow beams pierce multiple targets until the finite form ends.

ROSTER.name: Rook
ROSTER.role: Orbital salvager · pulse carbine, thruster vault and paired space turrets
ROSTER.primary: Pulse carbine — discrete aimed amber bolts, with no disc or tether.
ROSTER.secondary: Thruster Vault — make a short directional jetpack vault, keeping aim and carbine available; airborne height avoids ground melee, while projectiles and explosions still hit.
ROSTER.block: Energy guard — hold a rectangular amber shield.
ROSTER.special: Orbital Rig — deploy exactly two finite space turrets; carbine hits designate their target, and both require the operator nearby.

ROSTER.name: Mote
ROSTER.role: Genderless observatory keeper · glass and gravity
ROSTER.primary: Glass volley — three precise converging shards.
ROSTER.secondary: Gravity anchor — briefly draw nearby foes into a marked point.
ROSTER.block: Glass crescent — hold overlapping panes toward the threat.
ROSTER.special: Aphelion — the core opens; orbiting glass releases directed shard storms with each volley.
